## Why visit

A small-scale brewing experience with a distinctive origin: a former hardware shop now houses a pub with the brewing plant visible on a mezzanine above the bar. Own-brewed cask makes the journey meaningful for beer hunters, and the neighbourhood setting shows another side of Liverpool beyond the centre. The large open room and rear events space are a contrast to the historic snugs. Choose it when you want to meet local brewing in its everyday setting rather than chase only the most famous central pubs.
